commonProblems.h2: Peugeot 508 1.6 PureTech Engine Codes - Full Technical Specifications & Replacement Guide
commonProblems.h3: The 1.6-litre PureTech turbo engine code fitted to the Peugeot 508, with technical specs, compatible variants and trims, known failure points, and average rebuilt prices from UK specialists. Select the engine code to compare quotes.

finalCta.paragraph: History: The EP6FDT is the refined Gen 2 PureTech turbo engine, replacing the older EP6DT THP unit with improved reliability and efficiency. Produced from 2018 onwards, it powers the majority of Gen 2 508 petrol variants with 180hp in standard form and 225hp in GT Premium specification. The engine code variants include 5G02 (180hp), 5G04 (225hp), and 5GY (225hp with different calibration).
